rulings.claim: Anthony Notarian owned the premises located at 8127 Cedar Road, Chesterland, Ohio 44026, in Geauga County.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 1 shows a warranty deed granting the Geauga County premises to Anthony Notarian and identifies the Cedar Road tax mailing address.
rulings.evidenceQuote: ANTHONY NOTARIAN the Grantee whose TAX MAILING ADDRESS will be 8127 Cedar Road, Chester Township, Ohio 44026 ... premises, situated in the Township of Chester, County of Geauga and State of Ohio
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The supplied deed excerpt identifies Anthony Notarian as grantee and refers to the Geauga County premises with the Cedar Road tax mailing address.

rulings.claim: Anthony Notarian resided at 8127 Cedar Road, Chesterland, Ohio 44026.
rulings.reason: The record identifies Anthony Notarian as being of the Cedar Road address.
rulings.evidenceQuote: ANTHONY NOTARIAN, a single man ("Grantor"), of 8127 Cedar Rd., Chesterland, OH 44026
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The supplied excerpt identifies Anthony Notarian as being “of 8127 Cedar Rd., Chesterland, OH 44026,” which supports the residence/address assertion for record-citation purposes.

rulings.claim: Gino Notarian transferred Anthony Notarian's property to himself.
rulings.reason: The record states that Gino, acting under the power of attorney, transferred Anthony's real properties to himself.
rulings.evidenceQuote: On April 9, 2019, Gino Notarian-acting as an agent for Anthony Notorian under the 2005 General Durable Power of Attorney-transferred the real properties... 8127 Cedar Road... to himself.
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The quoted record passage states that Gino Notarian, acting under Anthony Notarian’s power of attorney, transferred Anthony’s real properties to himself.

rulings.claim: The property Gino Notarian transferred to himself was valued around $2 million.
rulings.problem: The bounded excerpts do not support the asserted approximately $2 million value.
rulings.reason: The available cited material discusses the Cedar Road property's $204,000 appraisal and the probate order references over $800,000 in real properties, but no excerpt states that the property transferred to Gino was valued around $2 million.
rulings.judgeReason: There is a concrete record-support concern because the supplied materials identify no excerpt stating that the property transferred to Gino was worth approximately $2 million, and the summarized available material instead references a $204,000 appraisal and over $800,000 in real properties. But because the negative finding is not shown as complete for all possible record support, Opponent has not established a must-fix defect.

rulings.reason: The probate court order expressly includes the Cedar Road property among the properties Gino transferred to himself.
rulings.evidenceQuote: On April 9, 2019, Gino Notarian... transferred the real properties... 8127 Cedar Road, Chesterland, OH 44026 (PPN: 11-244950), to himself.
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The quoted probate-court passage expressly includes 8127 Cedar Road among the properties Gino Notarian transferred to himself.

rulings.claim: Julia Notarian resided at the Cedar Road Property.
rulings.reason: The record states Julia Notarian resided at the house.

rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The supplied excerpt states that Julia Notarian resided at the house, supporting the asserted residence at the Cedar Road Property.

rulings.claim: Charles Rossbach III resided at the Cedar Road Property.
rulings.reason: The deed identifies Charles Rossbach and Julia Notarian as being of the Cedar Road address.
rulings.evidenceQuote: CHARLES R. ROSSBACH, a single man and JULIA M. NOTARIAN ("Grantors"), of 8127 Cedar Rd, Chesterland, OH 44026
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The supplied deed excerpt identifies Charles R. Rossbach and Julia M. Notarian as being “of 8127 Cedar Rd, Chesterland, OH 44026,” supporting the cited address/residence assertion.

rulings.claim: Julia Notarian resided at the Cedar Road Property without paying rent.
rulings.reason: The record states Julia Notarian resided at the house without paying rent.
rulings.evidenceQuote: Julia Notarian has resided at the house without paying rent since some time before the death of Anthony Notarian.
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The quoted record passage states that Julia Notarian resided at the house without paying rent since before Anthony Notarian’s death.

rulings.claim: Charles Rossbach III resided at the Cedar Road Property without paying rent.
rulings.reason: The notice addressed to Julia Notarian and Charles Rossbach III states they had not paid rent.
rulings.evidenceQuote: To: Julia Notarian and Charles Rossbach III... you have no rental agreement and are not a tenant; you have not paid any rent
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a record-support defect. The supplied record passage states that the notice was addressed to Julia Notarian and Charles Rossbach III and says they had not paid rent, which supports the challenged rent-nonpayment aspect of the claim.

rulings.problem: The cited probate record gives Anthony Notarian's date of death as February 21, 2020, not February 22, 2020.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 4 expressly states the decedent died on 02/21/2020.
rulings.evidenceQuote: Decedent died ... on 02/21/2020 domiciled in CHESTER TOWNSHIP.
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent carried its burden. The brief claim states that Anthony Notarian died on February 22, 2020, but the cited probate record states: "Decedent died ... on 02/21/2020 domiciled in CHESTER TOWNSHIP." The date in the brief is contradicted by the cited record.

rulings.claim: Maria Scalzo was appointed Fiduciary of the Estate of Anthony Notarian on July 7, 2020.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 4 shows Maria Scalzo was appointed fiduciary on July 7, 2020.
rulings.evidenceQuote: The Court therefore appoints MARIA SCALZO aka MARISA SCALZO as such fiduciary... Date: July 7, 2020
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a defect. The supplied probate record passage states that the court appointed Maria Scalzo as fiduciary and is dated July 7, 2020, supporting the claim.

rulings.claim: Letters of Authority were issued to Maria Scalzo for the Estate of Anthony Notarian.

rulings.claim: The Estate of Anthony Notarian filed an action against Gino Notarian and other defendants for the return of estate assets.
rulings.reason: The probate order describes a complaint by Maria Scalzo alleging Gino conveyed away estate real property.
rulings.evidenceQuote: Maria Scalzo alleges Gino Notarian concealed, embezzled, or conveyed away real property that belonged to Anthony Notarian to himself as Anthony's power of attorney.
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a defect. The supplied probate-order passage describes Maria Scalzo alleging that Gino Notarian concealed, embezzled, or conveyed away real property belonging to Anthony Notarian, which supports the existence of an estate-asset action against Gino.

rulings.claim: The estate-asset action was filed as Case No. 20 PC 000280 in the Geauga County Court of Common Pleas, Probate Division.
rulings.reason: The probate action is identified as Case No. 20 PC 000280 in the Geauga County Probate Division.
rulings.evidenceQuote: IN THE COURT OF COMMON PLEAS PROBATE DIVISION GEAUGA COUNTY, OHIO... CASE NO. 20 PC 000280
rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a defect. The supplied record identifies the matter as being in the Geauga County Court of Common Pleas, Probate Division, Case No. 20 PC 000280, supporting the claim.

rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a defect. The supplied record states that Gino Notarian transferred the 8127 Cedar Road property to Julia M. Notarian and Charles Rossbach on August 27, 2021, supporting the claim as to Julia Notarian.

rulings.judgeReason: Opponent has not established a defect. The supplied record states that Gino Notarian transferred the 8127 Cedar Road property to Julia M. Notarian and Charles Rossbach on August 27, 2021, supporting the claim as to Charles Rossbach III.
